title: Samsung Galaxy Glasses tasarımı ve teknik özellikleri sızdırıldı
summary: Samsung'un Android XR destekli yeni akıllı gözlüğü Galaxy Glasses hakkında şimdiye kadarki en kapsamlı sızıntı, cihazın ağırlığını, kamera özelliklerini ve çerçeve seçeneklerini ortaya koydu.
body:
Android XR altyapısıyla geliştirilen Samsung Galaxy Glasses için yapılan yeni bir sızıntı, cihazın teknik detaylarını ve farklı çerçeve tasarımlarını gözler önüne serdi. Samsung, temmuz ayındaki Galaxy Z Fold 8 tanıtımında ilk kez gösterdiği akıllı gözlüklerini 2026 yılı bitmeden piyasaya sürmeye hazırlanırken, SammyGuru'nun aktardığı bilgilere göre cihazın Kasım ayında Güney Kore ve ABD'de satışa çıkması bekleniyor.

## Teknik özellikler ve hafif tasarım

Android Police'in aktardığına göre, Galaxy Glasses standart lenslerle birlikte **41 gram** ağırlığında olacak. Bu oran, Meta Ray-Ban Gen 3 modelinin 51.5 gramlık ağırlığına kıyasla hafif bir yapı sunuyor. Cihazın **Qualcomm Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1** işlemciden güç alacağı, 2GB RAM ve 64GB dahili depolama alanına sahip olacağı belirtiliyor. Ayrıca 30 fps'de 3K video kaydı yapabilen 12 megapiksel kamera, açık kulak hoparlörler ve dahili mikrofonlar da cihazın özellikleri arasında yer alıyor. Şarj kutusuyla birlikte toplam 72 saate varan pil ömrü sunması beklenen gözlüklerin fiyatı ise henüz açıklanmadı.

## Çerçeve tasarımları ve markalar

Sızıntıya göre Samsung, farklı moda markalarıyla iş birliği yaparak geniş bir tasarım çeşitliliği sunacak. Gentle Monster altı farklı çerçeve stilinde 16 varyant sunarken, Warby Parker ise üç farklı tasarım hazırlıyor. Gentle Monster koleksiyonunda siyah, bordo ve krem gibi renk seçenekleri bulunurken; Warby Parker cephesinde ise Alden, Reid ve Wren modelleri tüketicilerle buluşacak. Satışların ABD'deki Samsung Experience Store mağazaları ile ilgili gözlük markalarının internet siteleri üzerinden yapılacağı ifade ediliyor.

**Neden önemli?** Sızıntı, Samsung'un akıllı gözlük pazarında Meta gibi rakip markalara karşı hafif tasarımı ve geniş marka iş birlikleriyle konumlanacağını gösteriyor.

source_texts.title: Samsung's smart glasses just got their biggest leak yet, with designs and specs laid bare
source_texts.summary: Samsung is all set to introduce its Android XR-powered Galaxy Glasses later this year, and a new leak has given us a closer look at the different frame designs that will be available, alongside some previously unknown specifications.
source_texts.text:
Samsung is all set to introduce its Android XR-powered Galaxy Glasses later this year, and a new leak has given us a closer look at the different frame designs that will be available, alongside some previously unknown specifications.
Samsung has already confirmed that the Galaxy Glasses will debut later this year. The company first showcased the glasses back in July during the    Galaxy Z Fold 8 launch event, but didn't reveal much about their availability at the time.
Since then, Samsung has confirmed that the glasses will arrive before the end of 2026, with most rumors pointing toward a November launch. However, plenty of details have remained under wraps. Now, a new leak from SammyGuru has revealed some of the key specifications, alongside a closer look at the different designs Samsung is preparing.
According to the publication, the Samsung Galaxy Glasses will weigh around 41 grams with standard lenses. That's noticeably lighter than the Meta Ray-Ban Gen 3, which weighs around 51.5 grams in its standard configuration. Under the hood, the Galaxy Glasses are expected to be powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 chipset, paired with 2GB of RAM and 64GB of onboard storage.
There will reportedly be a 12MP camera capable of recording 3K video at up to 30fps. Similar to other smart glasses, Samsung's offering will also feature open-ear speakers and built-in microphones, allowing users to take calls, listen to music, and interact with the glasses while on the go.
The glasses are also reportedly rated for up to 72 hours of battery life when used with the charging case. But perhaps the more interesting part of the leak is the number of frame designs Samsung is preparing. According to the publication, Gentle Monster will offer six different frame styles with up to 16 variants, while Warby Parker will introduce three designs.
Samsung's Galaxy Glasses could have one big advantage over Meta Ray-Bans
Gentle Monster's lineup (shown above) will reportedly include several different shapes, including a standard square frame, a rounder design, a bolder square frame, a cat-eye style, and slimmer oval-shaped options. The frames will be available in colors including black, burgundy, and cream, with lens options such as clear, light blue, brown, and gray, depending on the variant.
Warby Parker, meanwhile, will reportedly offer three designs called Alden, Reid, and Wren. The Alden and Wren frames will come in Pine (dark green) and Saddle (reddish-brown) colorways. The Reid design will reportedly be available in Jet Black. Buyers will also be able to choose between clear lenses and sunglasses for the different frame and color combinations.
According to the report, Samsung is planning to launch the Galaxy Glasses in November, with availability initially limited to South Korea and the U.S. There's still no word on pricing, but the publication claims the glasses will be sold through the respective eyewear brands' websites as well as Samsung Experience Stores in the U.S.
